The '''hands of doom''' were [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] produced in the [[Neimoidian droid factory]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. They defended the droid known as the [[Doom Bringer]] that was the main guardian of the factory. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Doom Bringer and its hands were destroyed by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who went on to shut down the [[Factory/Legends|factory]] that provided battle droids for [[HK-47]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />
